salary_details.details: In addition to the consolidated remuneration, Super Specialty Teaching Faculty will be entitled to transport allowance with DA on transport allowance as per rules. Consolidated remuneration is subject to revision matching DA rate changes as per Govt of India orders. No other allowances will be paid.

selection_process: The selection will be made on the basis of the performance of the candidate in an interview before the Selection Board.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and notification from the official website www.esic.gov.in.
Print the application form on A4 size paper.
Fill up all required details properly in the application form.
Prepare the application fee via Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable at Kolkata.
Compile one set of self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials along with two copies of recent self-attested color passport size photographs.
Report for the walk-in-interview between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM on 13 October 2026 at the Academic Block 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka.
Submit the filled application form with original documents, supporting copies, and Demand Draft during document verification.
important_instructions: The contract is purely for a period of three years or till the posting of a regular incumbent or attaining 70 years of age, whichever is earlier, subject to annual performance review. Maximum tenure of engagement will not exceed 70 years of age. The post is terminable by either side with a prior notice of one month without assigning any reason. No private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC. Retired candidates from Central/State Govt. / PSU from equivalent posts and persons working in recognized/approved Private Medical Institutions fulfilling eligibility criteria may apply. Candidates reporting beyond 10:30 AM for the interview shall not be considered. No TA/DA will be admissible for joining the institution, medical test, or submission of documents. The Dean, ESI-PGIMSR, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Joka reserves the right to vary vacancies, increase, decrease, cancel, or withdraw the offer of engagement without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Medical College Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in-interview recruitment notification released by ESIC Medical College Joka, Kolkata to engage Teaching Faculty for Super Specialty Departments in Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Medical College Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies advertised across various Super Specialty Departments for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in-interview for ESIC Kolkata Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview is scheduled for 13 October 2026. Candidates must report for document verification between 09:30 AM and 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting venue for the walk-in-interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should report at the Academic Block 2nd Floor of ESI-PGIMSR & ESIC Medical College, Joka, Kolkata - 700104.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The age limit of candidates should not exceed 69 years on the date of document verification and interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Medical College Kolkata Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for all other categories, while SC, ST, Regular ESIC candidates, Female candidates, and Ex-Servicemen are exempted with a fee of NIL.

faq.question: Q7. How is the application fee to be paid?
faq.answer: The fee must be paid via a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1", drawn on any scheduled bank payable at 'Kolkata'.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Professors receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 2,63,070/- per month, Associate Professors receive Rs. 1,74,936/- per month, and Assistant Professors receive Rs. 1,50,294/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is private practice allowed during service at ESIC?
faq.answer: No private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form and official notification from the official website www.esic.gov.in.
